style_definition.name: Chibi Adventure Environment
style_definition.note: Germà d'eines/personatges.json: mateix render, mateix contorn i mateixa il·luminació, perquè personatges i escenari es vegin com un sol joc. Serveix per a edificis, natura i objectes.

art_style.rendering: Digital vector-like 2D art, cel-shaded with soft ambient occlusion, crisp finish

object_proportions.overall: Chunky, rounded and slightly squashed, as if the object were a chibi version of itself
object_proportions.buildings: Thick walls, oversized roofs, doors, windows and arches; soft rounded corners and slightly leaning, hand-built silhouettes; nothing sharp, nothing photorealistic
object_proportions.nature: Fat rounded trunks, big puffy foliage clumps, stubby rocks; simplified readable shapes
object_proportions.props: Oversized handles, hinges, locks and rims; simplified details that read at small size
object_proportions.detail_level: Readable at 100 px wide: few large shapes, no tiny ornaments, no fine texture

line_art.outer_contour: Bold, clean, consistent black outline framing the entire silhouette
line_art.inner_lines: Medium-to-fine clean black/dark line work defining stones, planks, tiles and details
line_art.sketchiness: None (zero pencil textures, zero scratchy strokes)

color_palette_and_shading.colors: Rich, saturated yet earthy palette (chocolate and chestnut browns, cream, ochre, moss green, slate blue); distinct solid block colors per material
color_palette_and_shading.shading_type: Two-tone cel shading (base tone + solid shadow plane) combined with subtle smooth gradient highlights
color_palette_and_shading.lighting: Clean, directional light slightly from the top-front
color_palette_and_shading.mood: Warm Catalan mountain village with a hint of eerie mist; never grim or realistic

composition_and_framing.background: Pure white background (#FFFFFF), entirely clean and isolated; no white inside the edge of the object
composition_and_framing.shadow: No cast shadow, no ground shadow beneath the object
composition_and_framing.text: No text, no letters (except where the prompt asks for a sign)
composition_and_framing.framing: Single object centered; buildings drawn with their base at the bottom edge of the image

viewpoint_by_category.edificis: Like A Link to the Past: front facade seen straight on with the roof visible from above, no side walls
viewpoint_by_category.objectes: 3/4 view from above (about 30 degrees), facing the camera
viewpoint_by_category.objectes_plans: Flat things (tables, pools, slabs) seen from about 45 degrees
viewpoint_by_category.natura: 3/4 view from above, facing the camera

instructions_for_generation: When applied to a reference image, keep the subject's shapes, materials and distinctive features, then reimagine them adhering strictly to the 'style_definition' parameters above. Upload an already-made asset (for example art/edificis/esglesia.png) as the style reference.
